_comment: Screen errors that are known, reported and waiting on a decision, so
they do not turn every run red — a check that is always red stops being
read. Each entry matches a sweep error by screen, by shape (or `*`) and
by a piece of the error text. Matches are listed under their own heading
in the report, with the reason, and never fail a run. Remove an entry
when its bug is fixed: the run then fails if the error comes back.

issues.reason: raster map nav bar (lib/widgets/raster_map_nav_bar.dart:694) is a fixed height; at 1.5× text its place labels overflow. Needs a choice: let the bar grow, or clamp text scaling inside it.
same nav bar, landscape phone: too little height for thumbnails and place chips above the map.
